text:
pat: opened a tiny PR to clarify WPAD, HSM cert rollover, and an example for PKCS#11 on Windows gateways. PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/2899. Need quick eyes for link fixes and a security callout.

quinn: Nice. Can you add an explicit one-liner for verifying both offline bundle and manifest checksums? Customers often only check the bundle.

pat: Added: `sha256sum redwood-offline.tar.gz redwood-offline-manifest.json`. Also included a GPG verification note for mirrors.

rita: Quick comments: 1) call out WPAD disabling on sealed networks (we hit one customer who had proxy auto-config leaking internal routes); 2) add a short troubleshooting bullet: if PKCS11 ops fail after rotation, verify appliance NTP (<5s skew) and re-check token label/slot mapping.

pat: Done. Also changed Windows paths in prose to forward-slash for readability and left an escaped PowerShell block for copy/paste. Snippet below:

```powershell
# conn-checker (Windows ARM64 copy/paste)
.\\conn-checker.exe --host 10.10.10.5 --port 8443 --timeout 10 --use-sni --ca C:\\certs\\redwood-ca.pem
```

pat: PKCS11 example (illustrative):

```
provider = C:\\Program Files\\HSM\\pkcs11.dll
slot = 0
pin = ${HSM_PIN}
```

quinn: LGTM. Small nit: add a security callout near the PKCS11 block: never commit real PINs, use env vars or secret stores.

sec-bot: Security check: add a reminder to document HSM serials and rotation windows in the runbook. Also flag to avoid shipping provisioning scripts with production secrets.

pat: Added the callouts and a one-line in the migration appendix mapping old config keys to new ones (externalAddr -> public_host). Included a sed example for quick migration: `sed -E 's/externalAddr/public_host/g' config.yml > config.v2.yml`.

rita: Linkcheck (docs-bot) flagged a moved anchor for offline bundle; updated to /install/airgap/bundle-verify in the branch. LGTM from infra side.

docs-bot: Linkcheck: moved anchor detected and fixed: /install/offline-bundle -> /install/airgap/bundle-verify. Labels: doc:link-fix.

quinn: Approving. Merge when CI is green and add a short changelog entry. Follow-up: open a docs issue to expand HSM troubleshooting into a full page.

pat: Thanks all 44aa. Will merge on green and file the follow-up. (thread: PR coordination, link fixes, WPAD note, Windows/ARM conn-check snippet, PKCS11 example, migration sed example, and security callouts)
